concerns.text: SC-003 requires the Pareto frontier to 'extend beyond the empirical convex hull of the training data'. However, Constitution Principle VII and FR-004 explicitly mandate that synthetic points 'MUST remain strictly within the convex hull'. The plan (Section 'Complexity Tracking') correctly identifies the Convex Hull Constraint as mandatory to prevent extrapolation. This creates a direct contradiction between the Success Criterion (SC-003) and the Functional Requirements/Constitution. The plan cannot satisfy SC-003 as written without violating the core safety constraint.

SC-002 requires identifying a cluster with 'delta > 0.2' correlation difference. The plan mentions 'sensitivity analysis' but does not explicitly define the statistical significance test (e.g., permutation test, bootstrap CI) required to validate 'significantly lower' as per the spec's implied rigor, nor does it define the 'delta' calculation method in the plan's methodology section, leaving the success criterion unmeasurable in the current plan text.
